title: Full Report — Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories and Orders (M3-2, October 2026 data), 10:00 a.m. ET
source: CENSUS: two independent census.gov primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06. (1) economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, 178 rows parsed), row "Full Report - Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories and Orders | December 3, 2026 | 10:00 AM | October 2026", release code A202612031000, reference A202610. (2) manufacturing/m3/release_schedule.html (HTTP 200, 53,177 bytes), the M3 program's own grid, row "October 2026 | 11/25/2026 | 12/3/2026" under the columns "Advance Report on Durable Goods and Advance Total Manufacturing (8:30 a.m.)" and "Full Report (10:00 a.m.)" — the same grid row the durable-goods-2026-11-25 lane used to confirm this event's paired advance report. Promoted from the mtis-2026-12-16 lane's `estimate` proposal by this event's own initial research: the no-self-confirm convention binds the discovering sweep, not the independent second look, and the suspension caveat that kept the MTIS date an estimate does not apply here — no M3 row has ever been suspended (84 consecutive reference months for BOTH M3-1 and M3-2, 2019-11 through 2026-10, across seven Census calendars). Checked 2026-09-06
notes: The M3-2 full report supersedes the M3-1 advance (durable-goods-2026-11-25) for the same October 2026 reference month, eight days later — the median advance-to-full gap is 7 days (n=83, range 3-15). DISCOVERED by the mtis-2026-12-16 adjacency sweep on the argument that it supplies MTIS's manufacturers' leg, 35.1% of total business inventories. Initial research 2026-09-06 confirms that as PUBLICATION and refutes it as INFORMATION: isolating Atlanta Fed GDPNow vintages whose own `Data releases` text names M3-2 and nothing else (n=16, 2014-2026), the nowcast moves |d equipment| 0.0033pp and |d inventories| 0.0158pp — indistinguishable from a vintage naming no M3 report at all (permutation p=0.914 / p=0.731) — while vintages naming only the ADVANCE M3-1 move 0.0423pp and 0.0584pp (p<0.0001 / p=0.00015). The mechanism is dated and on Census's own page: since the June 2025 data released 2025-07-25 the advance publication carries detailed data for all nondurable industries, so this report's distinguishing coverage moved forward eight days seventeen months ago. Impact LOW, symbols empty: no house playbook is macro-keyed (0 hits re-grepped 2026-09-06) and no instrument attaches. Ledger: docs/research/events/m3-full-report-2026-12-03.md
